title: nolana incana
intro: Nolana incana, commonly known as Chilean saltwort, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Solanaceae. This plant is known for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce stress and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Nolana incana include its ability to act as an adaptogen, helping the body to adapt to physical and mental stress, and its potential to improve sleep quality. The bioactive constituents of Nolana incana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
